name: Glassmorphism
summary: Translucent panels that blur the colourful shapes behind them, edged with a thin light border. It spread after macOS Big Sur in 2020 and revives the glass of Frutiger Aero with real backdrop blur.

philosophy.core_thesis: Layers are readable when each one is a pane of frosted glass: it shows what lies beneath it and still keeps its own plane.
design_principles: Place panels over a vivid background of gradients or blurred shapes, because blur needs colour behind it to be visible.
Fill each panel with rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.15) to 0.25 and apply backdrop-filter: blur(16px to 24px) saturate(160%).
Add a 1px border of rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.3) on every panel, to mark the glass edge.
Use radii of 16px to 24px on panels and 12px on buttons.
Show depth by stacking: the further layer has a blur of 24px and the nearer layer a blur of 8px.
Keep one soft shadow of 0 8px 32px rgba(31, 38, 135, 0.2) under each panel, to lift it from the background.
Put text on a panel only when the area under it holds at least 4.5:1 contrast, or add a scrim of rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.25).
anti_patterns: Blur on a plain white or plain grey background where nothing shows through
Body text on a panel with less than 4.5:1 contrast to the blurred layer behind
Opaque panels with a faked frost texture and no backdrop-filter
Stacks of more than three overlapping glass layers
Panel borders thicker than 1px or darker than the fill
Hard black drop shadows under a glass panel
Blur radii above 40px on large areas, which cost frame rate

layout.grid_mechanics: A 12-column grid with 24px gutters; panels span whole columns and overlap background shapes by 10% to 30% of their area.
layout.whitespace_ratio: 35–50% of the surface is open; the spacing scale is 8, 12, 16, 24, 32 and 48px, and panel padding is 24px.
layout.alignment_rules: Left-aligned text inside panels; panels align to columns while the background shapes sit off-grid, so the glass reads as a separate plane.
layout.container_geometry: Panels use a 20px radius with a 1px light border; buttons use a 12px radius; avatars and chips use a full radius of 999px.

font_pairings.note: Friendly display weights over a neutral text face.
Geometric display with round counters that match the panel radius.

typography.tracking: Display sizes take -0.02em; body stays at 0; small labels take +0.02em.
hierarchy_rules: Use weight 600 or higher for text over glass, because weight 300 breaks up against a blurred background.
Set body text at 16px or larger and headings at 32px or larger on panels.
Use white text on dark backgrounds and near-black text on light ones; do not mix both on one panel.
Add a text-shadow of 0 1px 2px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.25) only to white text over a bright patch.

color.palette_structure: A saturated two or three hue gradient background, white translucent panels at 15% to 25% opacity, and one solid accent for the main action.

palette.name: Glass White
palette.role: panel fill at 15% to 25% alpha and border

color.contrast_rules: Glass cannot guarantee contrast, because the layer behind changes; test the worst patch of the background and reach 4.5:1 for text, with a rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.25) scrim where it falls short, and give each control a solid state for WCAG 3:1.
color.surface_treatment: Translucent fill of rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.15 to 0.25) with backdrop-filter blur(16px to 24px) and saturate(160%); an optional noise overlay at 3% opacity adds grain.
color.light_and_shadow: Light comes from the top left: a 1px inner highlight on the top and left edges of rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.5) and a soft shadow of 0 8px 32px rgba(31, 38, 135, 0.2).

materiality.surface_simulation: Frosted glass, a thin sheet that scatters the light behind it and shows its own edge.
materiality.border_rules: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.3) on all sides; a brighter 1px edge of 0.5 alpha on the top; no coloured borders.
materiality.blur_and_elevation: Background blur of 16px to 24px with saturate(160%); three levels: 8px blur for a toast, 16px for a card and 24px for a sheet, with shadows of 0 4px 16px, 0 8px 32px and 0 16px 48px.

ornamentation_details.iconography: Outline icons with a 1.5px to 2px stroke and round caps at 24px, in white at 90% opacity; filled variants for the active state.
ornamentation_details.illustration: Blurred gradient orbs and abstract 3D shapes placed behind the panels, so that the blur shows colour changes.

motion.transition_physics: Panels fade and rise by 8px to 16px while the blur radius eases from 0 to its final value, as if the glass slides into focus; no bounce.
motion.hover_and_active: Hover raises the fill alpha from 0.2 to 0.3 and lifts the panel by 2px; active drops the alpha to 0.15 and the lift to 0; focus adds a 2px solid #FFFFFF ring.

emotion.target_response: Light, airy depth: the viewer feels that the interface floats above a living background and is easy to see through.

avoid_when: Text-heavy screens need guaranteed 4.5:1 contrast, because the layer behind the glass changes under the text.
The target device is low-end, because backdrop-filter blur of 16px costs frame rate on weak GPUs.
The background is plain, because blur on a flat colour shows nothing and the panels look dirty.

modifiers.how: Raise the panel fill to rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.85) and cut the blur to 8px; keep the 20px radius and the 1px border.
Replace the border with the dual shadow 8px 8px 16px and -8px -8px 16px on a single neutral surface; keep the radius.
Add a 1px inner highlight, a glossy 135-degree gradient of 12% lightness and a deeper 0 16px 48px shadow; keep the blur.
Replace the blur and the soft border with a solid fill, a 3px black border and a 4px 4px 0 0 #000000 shadow.

pack.why: A light round line that stays legible on a blurred, bright surface.

ground.why: Frosted glass needs bright orbs of colour behind it, or the blur has nothing to show.
